note: Generated by scripts/import-design-systems.js. The palette is derived from tokens.css at check time, never duplicated here. Budgets marked "default" are the importer's conservative starting point — tighten them by hand once someone has built with the system.

typefaces.reason: Three faces, three jobs, taken from the upstream font tokens. A fourth family dissolves the system's voice.

elevation.reason: Elevation comes from the three derived levels. The upstream --elev-flat / --elev-ring values remain legal as edge treatments, but a new inline cast shadow is a fourth, undeclared level.

accent.reason: Importer default, deliberately loose: it has to accommodate the generated fixture, which fills the accent five times to demonstrate it (skip link, selection, swatch, primary button, statement band). A real page wants 2–3. Tighten this by hand once someone has built with the system — a budget nobody has tested is the weakest line in this file.

texture.reason: Added on import: a large flat fill is the most synthetic thing on a screen, and grain is also what stops big gradients banding.
